children: Silver Bow Mining signed a non-binding term sheet with Ocean Partners for an integrated potential US$88 million funding, credit support and ten-year zinc and lead offtake package.
Non-binding Term Sheet with Ocean Partners for ~US$88M: US$40M concentrate prepayment, ~US$43.1M bond guarantees, US$5M equity lead.
Approximately US$42M cash release expected from replacement reclamation bond guarantees (subject to DEQ acceptance and terms).
US$40M prepayment facility in three tranches (US$10M/US$20M/US$10M); US$5M pre-bridge to be funded within five business days.
Ten-year zinc and lead offtake agreements: 100% Rainbow Block, 100% non‑M‑Pit Montana Tunnels, one-third M‑Pit; no minimum tonnages or take‑or‑pay.
Financing structured junior to future senior project debt; definitive agreements targeted with Final Closing of Complex acquisition in Q4 2026.
